theme.archetype: ARCHETYPE 4: SWISS & HIGH-CONTRAST (Authority, Clarity, Truth) mixed with ARCHETYPE 2: THE PERFORMANCE PRO (Command-center focus)
theme.description: A high-density, tactical Dark Mode interface built for Network Operations Centers. Focuses on rapid status recognition, stark contrasts, and zero-distraction data consumption. The visual language exposes the technical grid.

headings.instruction: Used for page titles, major KPI numbers, and critical alerts. DO NOT use Inter for headings.

body.instruction: Clean, geometric sans for general UI text.

monospace.instruction: MANDATORY for all IPs, Latency (ms), Packet Loss (%), CPU/RAM metrics, and event log timestamps to ensure tabular alignment.

visual_enhancers.surface_strategy: Grid Borders (The 'Technical' Look). Use border-collapse style layouts for dashboard sections. Elements should have border-r and border-b with border-slate-800 to expose the skeleton of the UI.
visual_enhancers.tactical_glow: Critical 'DOWN' alerts should use a subtle inset red shadow or Tracing Beam effect to draw immediate operator attention.
visual_enhancers.glassmorphism: Avoid soft glassmorphism for data elements. Use solid flat surfaces (bg-slate-900) with crisp 1px borders to prevent visual refraction of dense metrics. Sticky headers can use backdrop-blur with a hard bottom border.
visual_enhancers.status_indicators: All status indicators (UP/DOWN) must include a pulsing dot (ping animation) next to the label to indicate real-time polling.

grids_and_layouts.strategy: MODE B: High Density Grid. Designed for maximum data correlation and scanability.
grids_and_layouts.spacing: Dense but optical. Use gap-4 or gap-6. Containers must have internal padding (p-4 or p-6).
grids_and_layouts.bento_dashboard: Summary metrics span 1 col, main topology/map spans 2 or 3 cols, and real-time event feed spans a tall 1-col narrow list on the right.
grids_and_layouts.alignment: Strict left-alignment for all tabular data, metrics, and labels to aid fast reading. Metric values and their labels must align perfectly.

component_strategy.ui_library: shadcn/ui primitives. Customize heavily: remove rounded-xl defaults, use rounded-sm or rounded-none for a sharper, technical NOC feel.
component_strategy.buttons: Sharp edges, solid colors for primary actions, subtle ghost variants for secondary. High contrast hover states.
component_strategy.tables: Dense rows. Monospace font for data cells. Use explicit hover states (hover:bg-slate-800) to help eye tracking across wide rows.
component_strategy.forms: Use Shadcn Form, Input, Select. Never use native inputs.
component_strategy.toasts: Sonner (bottom-right positioning for NOC event alerts, categorized by severity).

topology_graph.usage: Use custom nodes to display POP health (CPU, RAM, Status). Use animated edges (dashed lines moving) to represent traffic flow. Edge colors must map to Link Status (Green/Red/Amber).

geographic_map.usage: Use CartoDB Dark Matter or Stadia Alidade Smooth Dark tiles for the map base to match the dark theme. Render POPs as markers and Links as Polylines (cable paths).

charts.usage: Use for CPU/RAM and Traffic history. Minimal grid lines, solid stroke lines with gradient fills beneath.

motion.micro_interactions: Hover states must instantly increase border contrast and slightly lift the element (-translate-y-[1px]).
motion.status_pulses: Use a subtle scale/opacity loop animation for 'Live' indicators (absolute w-2 h-2 rounded-full animate-ping).
motion.transitions: Use specific transitions (e.g., transition-colors duration-150) rather than 'all'. Do not apply transitions to layout dimensions to prevent jank.

icons.style: duotone or regular weight. Excellent for technical interfaces.

login_background.description: Dark fiber optic network abstraction used for the authentication screen background to establish technical authority.

accessibility.testing: All interactive elements (buttons, links, map markers, form inputs) MUST have data-testid attributes (e.g., data-testid='pop-status-card', data-testid='link-management-tab').
accessibility.contrast: Ensure all text against dark surfaces meets minimum 4.5:1 ratio. Never use pure #000000 for backgrounds. Never use grey-on-grey for critical metrics.
accessibility.motion: Respect prefers-reduced-motion for the topology animated edges and status pings.

instructions_to_main_agent: You are building a high-performance NOC Dashboard. The interface must look technical, dense, and authoritative.
Do NOT use soft, fluffy borders (rounded-2xl) or generic Vercel-like SaaS aesthetics. Use sharp edges (rounded-sm), tight spacing, and high contrast.
For the Map Component, wrap it in a client-side only approach or use appropriate dynamic imports if using Next.js/React to avoid SSR issues with Leaflet.
For the Topology Graph (@xyflow/react), create custom React components for the nodes to display real-time CPU/RAM/Status inside the node itself.
Ensure the sidebar navigation is compact. Use Phosphor icons.
Do NOT center-align the main app layout. It is a full-width, 100vh grid layout.
Whenever displaying IPs, ping latency, or packet loss, ALWAYS use the IBM Plex Mono font family.
Do NOT use transparent backgrounds for headers or sticky menus. Use bg-slate-950/95 with a solid bottom border.
universal_guidelines: You tend to converge toward generic, 'on distribution' outputs. Make creative, distinctive frontends that surprise and delight.
Dark colors look good when used independently without gradients. DO NOT use dark colors as gradients.
Don't make generic centered layouts, simplistic gradients, and uniform styling.
Create depth through layered design elements with z-index hierarchy and crisp 1px borders.
You MUST NOT apply universal transition (e.g., transition: all). Add transitions for specific properties.
You MUST NOT center align the app container. Do not add .App { text-align: center; }.
Always use modern button styles, sharp with interaction animations & color relevant to the app style.
NEVER use AI assistant Emoji characters like 🤖🧠💭💡🔮🎯 for icons.
Use sonner for toasts, located in /app/src/components/ui/sonner.tsx.
